summary: Added 'edit' CLI command to allow users to modify todo text via command line

implementation_details.todoapp_rename_method: Added rename() method to TodoApp class that finds todo by id, calls Todo.rename() method, and saves
implementation_details.edit_subparser: Added 'edit' subparser with id (int) and text (string) arguments
implementation_details.edit_handler: Added edit command handler in run_command that calls app.rename() and outputs sanitized success message

acceptance_criteria_met: Running 'todo edit 1 new text' modifies todo with id=1
Empty text triggers 'Todo text cannot be empty' error
updated_at is automatically updated after modification
tests_description: test_cli_edit_command_sanitizes_output - verifies terminal security (control char escaping)
risks: None - minimal change that reuses existing Todo.rename() validation logic
